title: English Language Instruction for College
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

program.section_heading: English Language Instruction for College Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Demonstrate ability to critically reason, research, and analyze readings at the college level.
Demonstrate competent control over written language, academic form, style, and tone at college-level composition.

notes: The catalog prints codes without a space (ELIC140, ELIC100); ELIC100 is matched to closed-list ELIC 100.
ELIC140 (7 units) is not in the closed list and is recorded as a catalog addition.
The REQUIRED COURSES block sits inside an outer 'English Language Instruction for College (Total 12) Complete all of the following' group; recorded as one block.
Each course must be completed with a grade of C or better.

A stray 'Upon satisfactory completion of this award, the student should be prepared to:' lead-in appears in the description with no outcomes under it; the outcomes are recorded from the Program Learning Outcomes heading.
Certificate total is 12 units, within the 8 to fewer than 16 semester-unit award range.
